default.description: 2 hours: no order of ours asks for the default, so a leaf this long names a request that left its profile out.

tlsserver.description: The domain profile. 55 minutes: long enough that a freshly issued certificate is not inside the window CertMagic renews within (five 10-minute check intervals, so 50 minutes), short enough that it is inside that window one check interval later. A background maintenance renewal is therefore observable about 10 minutes after a server starts. Pebble issues notAfter one second short of the period and does not backdate notBefore.

shortlived.description: The IP profile. 50 minutes, distinct from the other two, so a leaf's lifetime names the profile it was ordered under.
